description: Open one product to offers, or change it: this saves the product whole (create or replace). Buyers see the list price and never the floor price, which is never breached; the floor cannot exceed the list price. Each product has its own switch, off unless you set enabled. Needs a Last Price credential with routing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

currency.description: A three letter ISO 4217 code. Defaults to USD.

enabled.description: Whether buyers can make offers on this product.

floor_price.description: The lowest price you will accept. Never shown to buyers.

max_rounds.description: Rounds for this product, instead of the workspace setting.

product_id.description: Your own id for the product, as buyers name it in an offer.

title.description: A name for your own reference.

unit_cost.description: Your cost per unit, read by the margin and cost guardrails.

name: set_offer_product
